d: The Jedi and Nash are sent on the wrong missions.
Newton wants to check out an asteroid but it's a trap

While on a mission to clean up a forest, Min and the Octonauts discover a hollow, dried-out tree that's inhabited by all kinds of creatures. When the tree becomes threatened, the Octonauts must move it!
When Gordon leaves Thomas in charge for the day, Thomas sees it as his chance to prove what a good leader he is. As problems arise, he finds that leadership is about more than just being boss.

It's time for the mysterious magic show, hosted by The Three Threes. Using jugs and cups, they dazzle the audience with  the amount of stuff that fits inside any container tall or wide and teach them a new word; ca-pa-city!
Peppermint the grocer has a lot of carrots. What's more, Monsieur LaFleur is on his way with even MORE. Peppermint doesn't want to disappoint him, so she tries to sell the carrots fast!
What happens when your truck breaks down in the snow? You call a tow truck! Join Fantus to see how they work.

Grandpa Pig has a big surprise for Peppa and George. He has built them a beautiful tree house in his garden, with cute little curtains on the window. Peppa loves being in the tree house and invites everyone else to come in.
Get ready to sing along with Simon. He's creating a brand-new rhyming song and, with help from his Wiggly friends, finds the perfect words to make a mighty tune!
The farmer receives a mystery gift from his antipodean cousin. Unimpressed with the present, he attempts to throw it away only for it to keep reappearing. He becomes convinced it has magical powers.
Green Goblin and Rhino take over a bridge and threaten to destroy it!
The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they've found. When they're not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.
Bitsy worries that she and Ginny can only be besties if they like the same things. Zsa-Zsa freezes everyone for her group selfie, and Ginny figures out how to use Cat-o-flauge.
Snobby King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit the Little Kingdom, and Holly and her Mummy and Daddy enlist the Elf Band to impress them.
Flower and her friends decide to make a movie starring Flour during the school holidays. While not as easy as it first seems, the challenges eventually prove to be part of the fun.
Flower rediscovers her magical Oogga Sugga straw and tries it out on Dad, but it breaks! With Flour's help, she repairs it, finally spreading Oogga Sugga fun to Dirk, Penny, and even herself.
Peppa and her family are going to the Water Park. Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park but first you need to put on your swimsuit.
Peppa and George have come to play at Granny and Grandpa's house. Grandpa Pig comes to meet them at the front door.
When Mum goes out to a baby shower, Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine. But with Bluey missing Mum, Dad has to pull out all the games he knows to keep them entertained.
After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in 'Dance Mode' as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.
A young Broccoliosaurus isn't tall enough to reach the delicious blooming flowers high in the trees until Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes come up with an ingenious way to get to them.
Ginger challenges the Baby Pea-Rexes to a race around Vegesaur Valley... with no rules! First one in the water hole wins!
Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.

Duggee gets a delivery, which arrives in a big cardboard box. The squirrels discover that cardboard boxes can be great fun. Roly makes a car out of one, Tag makes a tunnel then all the squirrels make a big cardboard castle!
Today at Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.
Fizzy and Suds tie themselves in knots exploring the strength of rope through factories, high-ropes courses, and First Nations weaving traditions, ending with a hula-hoop craft.

Alex, Leah, and Auslan Translator Melissa, are exploring the sense of sight! They create a rainbow colour wheel with items in the Sensational Sensory Space, and the toys go on a walk to look for nighttime creatures!
Fiona calls the Piggies to help tidy up her garden, but they bring along a game that drives them crazy. Can they manage to work and play without causing a bigger mess?
Bonnie steals Lorelai's bracelet, turning herself into a mermaid and trapping Lorelai in human form! / Santi and crew must overcome ghostly shenanigans to save Cecilia from the dreaded Ghost Ship.

An animated swash-buckler based on the much-loved children's book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler. The tale of a greedy rat who craves buns and biscuits, but comes to a sticky end.
When Jay finds a worm in the garden, the family decide to have a worm charming championship! Nikhil's not so sure about worms. He has a spot of wriggly worries and doesn't want to take part.
While playing 'castle', the Creato-crew build a ball-throwing device to entertain their furry little dragon, Wallace.
Grumblestunk is sure she saw an enormous banana when she walked Stink on the beach early that morning and Stan and Gran spy a mystery, but no banana!
Miffy and her friends plant a friendship garden together, which Miffy loves until she discovers someone is picking their flowers.
Pants shows Mittens how he buries bones then digs them up again. Mittens tries to help, but isn't sure she'll ever understand dogs.
Mittens and Turnip hear tales of a mysterious ball that is haunting Kibble Corners. They go on the hunt to find out what it is.
Anthony's belongings have made a mess in the Wiggly lounge room. The Wiggles need to get it cleaned up for Wags' upcoming Wiggly dog dance. Will Do-Do, the cleaning robot, be able to help?
Are you ready to Do Dis Do Dis? Join Takaya to learn some cool Hip Hop dance moves. Bounce, shake, clap, or even freestyle your own moves along to Everybody Do This!
It's the first day of Pup School. Dodge overcomes his first day nerves as he meets lots of new friends. The pups settle into their class activities with their new teacher Miss Collie.
Thomas and Kana journey across Sodor to find the prize at the end of a rainbow.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play Bat and Ball, she teaches them so well that they beat her at the game and win!
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox dig a huge tunnel and find a box of pirate treasure and the police seem to be missing their pirate treasure. Something mysterious is going on.
When a strange space craft crash-lands on the farm, Shaun and co help its little green occupant get air-borne again.
When Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes' yummy drops get snatched by a group of Beetrootsaurus, so begins a game of Pea-in-the-Middle to get them back.
Naughty Gaston is sent to pet school, where Miss Jolly soon gets him into shape.
When Flower loses her first tooth, she enlists Flour the cat to help keep it safe and make sure the tooth fairy can find it.
When Mr. Puppypaws pretends Poochissimo's piano playing is his own, the SuperKitties set out to reveal the truth.
When Barbarito swipes the Windless Sail from Pig Island, the crew teams up their new pig friends to retrieve it.
PJR wants to be Newton's Space Buddy. But first he needs to power up!
The Octonauts must get two mantis shrimp to stop fighting before their powerful claw strikes destroy the Octopod.

The squirrels are playing 'Copy the King' when Tag falls over and bumps his knee. Ouch. Duggee has his First Aid badge, so he can bandage Tag up. The squirrels want to help too and they practice their bandaging on Happy.
Big Trev tells Pounce and Gemma a tale from his childhood as they wait for his elderly turtle friend, Salty, to arrive.
When Norman scares the hayride horse at the County Fair, Sarah, Hannah and Mike are stuck on a runaway cart racing through town! Radar to the rescue!
When Nana reveals she's never had a dosa, the family all try something new and have a Never-Done-It day! Will Nikhil and Jay be able to find something Jim has never done before?
How do the Odd Blocks and Even Tops work out who's best? Dance! Learn about odd and even numbers to 20 with the Numberblocks.
The Makery presents Nim with ideas for a bendy road picture, a pepper octopus dip and a sweet cake costume with matching hat!
At the beach, it's so much fun making sandcastles and watching crabs. Come join our beachy bubbles and don't forget to slip, slop, slap to stay sun safe!

Abi & Matt meet Mara, a volunteer from the State Emergency Service! We learn about the SES uniform & equipment & SES worker, Dan, helps the toys after a big storm. Through The Windows, we see more SES workers in an animation.
The Super Monsters celebrate Christmas with a magical Wish Star that grants heartfelt wishes and sparks chaos, teaching lessons about teamwork, friendship, and the joy of the holiday spirit.
Little J and Big Cuz discover that super heroes come in all sizes.
One his first day as new Head Teacher, Andy's determined to keep everyone happy. But with arguments over what Dance the kids should do, he's forced to take drastic action.
Miss Collie brings her pet stick insect, Woody, to class, but halfway through the day, Woody mysteriously vanishes!
World Cup fever has taken over the Plaza! But when the live telecast is interrupted, Flower and Flour find a way for the whole plaza to have their own World Cup soccer match.
The junior gardeners visit the Arboretum in Canberra and learn all about the mindful art of Bonsai.
Peppa receives an invite to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double decker bus arrives, this is where the party is! The bus goes to the playground and even the beach. It's the best party ever!
Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break too.

When Dasha is away, Andrew expects Captain Wonderful to do everything the same way as his Mum. When Captain Wonderful learns to perfectly imitate Dasha, Andrew discovers that what he really misses is his Grandpa after all.
The Super Monsters save Christmas by helping Santa repair a North Pole mishap, learning the value of teamwork, responsibility, and spreading holiday joy while delivering presents with Grrbus.

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: When Iron Friend imposters cause chaos, the team must clear their names. Vision's art tour turns dangerous as Ultron threatens to make the museum vanish.
The Farmer decides it's time to give the flock a shearing. But when they see his first attempt, Shaun and co plan their escape.
Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.
Spark isn't feeling well but Madam Dragon insists he is fine, just over-excited for his lesson. Zog's intuition tells him Madam Dragon is wrong, but can he tell her?
Mae and Bee encourage their friend, Tiger, a blind witch's cat, to trust his senses and find his lost place in the treetops, bringing the spark back to his magic whiskers.
Kevin loses his heirloom gum that he chewed for 367 days straight. Everyone agrees that's gross, but Superbuns is always there to help a friend no matter what!
The SuperKitties stop Zsa-Zsa from turning the Kittydale Water Tower into her own giant bubble bath.
While gardening, Wizz accidentally sprays Keith with Boom Bloom, a spray that makes things grow before our eyes.
During a game of bus, passenger Mum is too scared to tell Bus Driver Dad that she secretly loves him, until she gets some help from the Grannies.
To win Tom Gleeson's Big Brass Mug, an eclectic collection of young experts are grilled on their knowledge of One Piece, the Irwins, The Baby-Sitters Club, and Electric Light Orchestra!
The young Jedi find and rescue Master Yoda.
Luna Steals Owlette's voice, imperilling the school music concert. Owlette wants it back so bad she doesn't work well with Icecub
When rising water levels threaten to wipe out albatross nests, the Octonauts build a break-wall and look for a new place to relocate the albatrosses.
Thomas and friends think their friendship with Kana is in trouble when she says she needs some alone time. But when her friends take it too far, will she be able to recharge?
At Five's new smoothie cafe, the Numberblocks discover that it doesn't matter which order you add two numbers in - the answer's the same!
Winkles has just finished building the preschool for the baby chicks. Unfortunately, there's nothing inside. Winkles realizes that a mechanic shop for preschoolers may not be right. But what is?
Join Fantus and see how Snowmobiles can be fast and fun - but also helpful on the slopes.

Peppa and George are having a fancy dress party. Peppa is dressed as a fairy princess and George is a scary dinosaur. Peppa has to judge the best costume and finds it quite difficult not to pick herself.
Lachy and Anthony, together with Lucia and Wags the Dog, are going on a camping trip! Join them for this outdoor adventure complete with a tent, fishing, camping songs, and even a spooky story?

Every time the postman pays the Farmer a visit, Bitzer's canine instincts get the better of him, resulting in shredded mail and an irate farmer. Shaun decides to help out by taking on the role of Bitzer's therapist.
When Gobby repaints the masterpieces at the museum, Miles saves the day!
Carrot is starring in her own circus and thinks that Supertato is trying to steal her limelight. She soon realises that Supertato is trying to rescue her from Evil Pea's meddling.
Sparks faces his fear of getting his face wet to stop Zsa-Zsa from ruining the Paddlepaws Express boat ride. Lab Rat steals Fishy Cake for Otto's birthday, trapping Bitsy.

Things are going missing all over the Little Kingdom - Holly has lost her wand and Ben has lost his horn! Soon they realise that ants are stealing their things, and try to persuade the Queen Ant to give them back.
When a wheel-less golf buggy is dumped in the plaza, the neighbourhood kids band together to turn junk into art.

Flower decides cats shouldn't say 'meow' anymore, and soon Flour is speaking only in 'beep beep.' When Cockatoo takes a liking to Flour's new language, Flower feels left out as the two new friends romp around the plaza.
It's Pedro Pony's birthday and he is having a superhero party. Pedro is dressed up like Super Potato and to Pedro's surprise all the children are also dressed like Super Potato.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are spending a day helping Dr Hamster the Vet. They are learning all about what vets do.
On a trip to Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo create their own mini-homes side-by-side in the trolley. But Bluey quickly gets jealous of her neighbour Bingo.
Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.
Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes help a lost Baby Cuke back to its herd, but the teething Cuke's incessant need to suck makes the process more difficult than expected.

A Baby Kiwimammathus gets stuck on a small patch of fast-melting snow. Its soft feet means it can't move across hard surfaces, so Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes must come up with a clever plan to get her back home.
Spark isn't feeling well but Madam Dragon insists he is fine, just over-excited for his lesson. Zog's intuition tells him Madam Dragon is wrong, but can he tell her?

The squirrels are helping Duggee in the garden when Tag makes friends with a caterpillar. This caterpillar is very hungry, so Tag feeds her all the vegetable leaves they've been picking. She eats and eats and eats!

It's a lovely warm day for the beach. The squirrels learn how to make sand castles. They are doing such a good job that Jon and Nigel the crabs ask if the squirrels could work together to build them a new home.
The junior gardeners visit the Arboretum in Canberra and learn all about the mindful art of Bonsai.

Matt, Abi, and Auslan Translator Oliad, learn about  the sense of touch and body awareness. They play dress up with lots of different textured fabric, Matt dresses up as a hungry snail, and Abi makes a pinch pot out of clay!
Fred and Dana ask the Piggies to plan fun outdoor games for Keith and Rebecca. Each Piggy comes up with an idea, but Cesar's is so ambitious that he can't tackle it alone!
When Escarlata turns the crew tiny, they have to find a pint-sized way to save the day. / It's time for the annual Pirate Parade! That is, unless Escarlata has anything to say about it.
Luna secretly steals Motsuki's teleport power. Gekko and Catboy investigate, but mess up with catastrophic results. Can they find it in themselves to put it right?

Join the Tree of Wisdom and the Little Tree of Wisdom as they have a dance competition! Who can do the sprinkler head dance move better? Then dance along to 'Red as a Lobster' and see what happens to John Wiggle in the sun!
When Nikhil and Jay hear Amma and Appa talking about a Star Birthday they try to find out what it is. Through misunderstanding they make it a Star Birthday to remember!
When Millie can't find her bead kit in order to make her mum a gift, she turns the Imaginarium upside-down, realising she needs a better way to organise things.
A giant Albatross has been seen near Porthole and Stan has to spot it! But the bird's footprints are bigger than any real Albatross. What's going on?
Miffy gives Bun what she thinks is a cool present for his birthday, but he's much more interested in the box it came in!
After learning that Pineapple sleeps during the day, Mittens tries to get everyone in Kibble Corners to quiet down for her friend's cat nap.
When Mittens stays home to wait for the cat-pops to freeze, she ends up helping the many citizens of Kibble Corners get ready for the parade.

Get ready for a Wiggly adventure as The Wiggles are 'Dressing up In Style,' and you're invited to join in! The Wiggles host a special tea party with their adorable teddy bears, Bowie, Allen, Ollie, and Francesca.
Are you ready to do The Skit Skat? Emma has her dancing pants on for moving and grooving! Slide and kick along to Dancing Pants.
Dodge is eager to win the Class Star award, but how will he out shine Cherry the superstar at everything? Dodge discovers that the real key to winning the Class Star award is by trying his best.
When a parade balloon Nia is set to deliver flies away, Thomas helps Nia adjust her plans to get it back.

It's Valentine's Day! Daddy Pig gives Mummy Pig a card, but Mummy's card to Daddy hasn't arrived. Everyone is sad that Daddy didn't get a card. But when the post finally arrives, there's a big surprise.

Peppa and her family visit a big shop full of little shops! Mummy is visiting the spa for a 'Perfect Day Experience', so Peppa, George and Daddy Pig explore the shopping centre in search of their own perfect days!
The Farmer decides to get a robotic sheep-dog, but when it turns out to be even stricter than Bitzer, Shaun decides it has to go.
The Bananaraptors fall into a deep hole and Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes must think of a clever and creative way to get them out safely.
With so many rescue missions, Elf Rescue needs a helping hand from Children Rescue.

When House of Bargain gets a dodgy delivery of only left flip-flops, Louie Louis is devastated. Flower and Flour step in to show him the Luck Makers' way, proving weird opportunities can be wonderful.
Zsa-Zsa spreads colourful clouds all over Kittydale to create a never-ending rainbow.
When Anani learns of a treasure chest filled with magic pearls, she enlists the help of the Pirate Protectors to find it.
Cat Boy wants to be able to teleport to the moon like Motsuki.
When a storm washes Peso onto a mysterious, rocky island, he meets a band of lobster-like insects thought to be extinct.

Duggee has a pot of bubble mixture, and he's blowing fantastic bubbles. It's really hard to do but most of the squirrels eventually get the hang of it, and the club rapidly fills up with lots of bubbles. Pop, pop, pop!
On a paddle board expedition, the cadets get 'stranded' on a desert island. Meanwhile, Neville goes on a journey to become the ultimate balance master.
Mike and Charlie are looking for the rare spotted ray, when they lose control and the boat begins sinking. Quick! Call Ocean Rescue!
Nikhil and Jay celebrate Deepavali (Diwali) with their family, with kolam, laddus and bunting. But will they be able to watch the fireworks without scaring Max the Cat?
Twenty-One helps some new friends find out how many rectangles they can make. Learn about the numbers 23 and 24 and explore arrays with the Numberblocks.
Nim is going to a fancy-dress party today which gives the Makery lots of fancy animal ideas including a pigeon soap pump, a bread bird and a roar-some dinosaur hat.
Who loves sushi? Fizzy and Suds do! Join our bubbles as they find out how to make this delicious healthy food. All aboard the sushi train!

Zindzi and Teo meet Reem, a volunteer for Australian Red Cross! We learn about donating at a fundraising stall, before Teo and Zindzi put on a concert for the toys! Through The Windows, we see more volunteers in an animation.
Peppa and her family are going on holiday with Suzy and her family to The Big Tree Nature Park!
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like! So, Peppa and George step in to help train him.
Big Cuz fears she's bitten off more than she can chew when she offers to organise the school's radio broadcast.
In an effort to sign up a famous rock duo to the Big Music Project, the Odd Socks help turn the school into a Rock Star Club. But with the singers at war, disaster strikes.
Miss Collie challenges the pups to build a raft to carry a dog biscuit across a paddling pool. Dodge, Woofer and Jazz learn that working together is the key to success.
While Flower, Penny, and Dirk head out for the day, Flour the cat sneaks off on his own mischievous adventure around the plaza.
After raking up some flowers, Hannah, Kiki and Kai have a scent-sational idea! They collect rosemary, lavender, camellias and lemons to make a sweet smelling potion.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect art piece at Suzy's house.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers. The children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells, and even a rare orchid!
Andrew and Gregasus want to play and make lots of noise, much to the annoyance a bossy g'nome who wants peace and quiet.

A cheerful five-year-old girl named Georgie gets to grow her very own pine tree, Piney, on her Grandpa Sid's Christmas tree farm. Four years later, the day has finally arrived for Piney to become what he was planted to be.

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: Tony promises his friends a park day, but Ultron steals the toys. Then, Amadeus upgrades a truck, but accidentally turns it into a giant chicken!
When the Flock nip off on the bus to the local funfair, it's up to Shaun to convince the Farmer that nothing is wrong until Bitzer can round up the lost sheep.
Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!
Winton has terrible toothache but isn't ready to lose his fang. Zog and the doctors must help him feel proud again of the way he looks.
When Mae blows all but one seed off a dandelion, she accidentally creates a wish filled magic wand. However, her spells spiral out of control as she tries to fix magic with magic!
When it seems like Rhonda has stood Neil up for their playdate, Buns is sure it's a misunderstanding and goes looking for her. But her extra-long cape that MeeMaw made her trips her up to no end!
The SuperKitties stop Lab Rat, after she kicks all the groundhogs out of their special space.
Wizz has promised his friend Nessie that he will perform a dance with her at the end of the show, but he is very nervous and doesn't want any extra eyeballs watching!
During a game of Queens, Bluey and Bingo find that playing the butler is much more fun. But someone must play the Queen, even if it means not being afraid of a bit of hard work.

Debra-Jo and Tamara each enter the school talent quest but discover to their horror that they are performing the same song. Scared of being outdone by the other, they ask Melanie to choose who will be better.
Kai must protect a fossil site from being damaged.
Catboy encourages Icecub to mess around with his snowballs but the Wolfies take advantage

A grumpy honey badger takes over a savanna's main watering hole, so Kwazii challenges her to a digging challenge as a way to utilize her help in digging out a new watering hole for the rest of the animals.
Thomas is chosen to deliver Sir Topham Hatt's prized roses to Sodor's Annual Flower Festival, but when a skunk sprays him, his foul stench and attempts at fast-fixes threaten to derail the whole day!
The Odd Blocks are meeting for their special club! These Numberblocks have an odd block on top, so where does Numberblock One fit in?
When Mayor Sourdough asks Pants to 'watch Nanna Ribbit', Pants didn't think he'd have to chase her around all day, while she goes off on daring adventures.
How do cherries get picked from their trees? Come see this amazing machine with Fantus.

Peppa and her family visit the museum. Peppa enjoys the Kings and Queens' room and imagines being a Queen. George's favourite room is the dinosaur room. Daddy's favourite room is the one with the cakes - the museum cafe!
Tsehay has made some lemonade to share with her friends! There is some for Simon, but then there is no lemonade left for Anthony. What to do? Dorothy flies off in the Big Red Plane for help.
It's Love Day in Windsor Gardens. Mr Brown has forgotten to book a table for Mrs Brown at the cafe and Paddington is on a mission to deliver Love Day cards to all his friends.

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: While camping, the Iron Friends track down missing snacks.
Catboy wants to help solve a mystery, but Owlette and Gekko are only interested in his super speed.
Spidey's offer to let Hulk hang out in WEB-Quarters quickly turns into a disaster.
A new fish wants an adventure of her own.
Promising not to waste a single bite, Mae and Bee find their giant strawberry might actually be more than they can handle, especially with hot sun threatening to turn it to mush!
Flower wants new toys, but Penny says she has too many. Flower decides to give away her old stuff and discovers that sharing sparks unexpected fun for herself and all her friends.
George is sad when Suzy Sheep comes to play and Peppa won't let him join in their games. Later, when Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is happy to be the patient.
When Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.
A Mandarinteryx has moved into homebase and is causing a big mess. In order to move it along, they have to find it a partner, and quickly.
When Neville builds a drone to help make sure local great white shark Charlene doesn't come too close to the beach, it proves to be better than the lifeguards. almost.
Annette and Clarion solve a giant underwater mystery and learn about preventative creature care.
A shark in Swoppiton? Mojo and Bo go on a fishing trip to find out!
Andy travels back 65 million years to the time of triceratops, a plant-eating dinosaur which roamed the plains of North America.

t: Play School: Let The Music Play
d: Strum along with Alex and Abi in the Play School Sound Studio as they use harmony and melody to sing together. Kiya and Dan are on the farm and use special calls for the animals to come home for dinner.
Mandy and Sarah try to get the big scoop on who the special guest performing at the Big Pontypandy Festival will be!
Aria, Riff, and Zip find a friendly frog at the pond! They decide to take him home, but Hum isn't sure their house is the best place for a frog.
The Woohoos want to build a den but the things they try to build it with don't work so it keeps falling down. They work out that the materials and the Woohoos need to work as a team.

t: Guess How Much I Love You
d: Little Grey Squirrel leaves his acorns unattended to go and play. Little Redwood Fox discovers the acorns and takes them. Once she finds out they belong to Little Grey Squirrel, she has to decide whether to give them back.
When Melanie goes on vacation, Miffy feels lost without her best friend and struggles to have fun with others.
The Sound Collector's house is trashed. But maybe Mole isn't the culprit this time.
When Pants finds mysterious gifts just for him, he searches everywhere for Mittens so he can share the news with his best friend. But where is she?!
BaBa loves playing with a noisy drum but discovers that not everyone likes loud noises.
The toddlers are visited by a rat. Fantus helps a little toucan find its parent.
During a game of Queens, Bluey and Bingo find that playing the butler is much more fun. But someone must play the Queen, even if it means not being afraid of a bit of hard work.
Fizzy and Suds head to the skies to learn all about bats - they have more in common with bees than you'd think! They also use sonar to navigate at night when searching for food.
Tammy and the junior gardeners create the ultimate dinosaur backyard garden paradise, rawwwr!

Tsehay faces gardening trouble with her sunflowers and Lachy, the gardening expert, steps in to offer advice. The Wiggles sing the 'Garden Barcarole' outside as Lachy continues sharing his gardening wisdom.

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: While camping, the Iron Friends track down missing snacks.
Roof is delivering eggs to Marwyn at the Treetop Woods Train Station, that is, until the train pulls into the station and is unable to stop!
When Percy loses Nia's parade flag before the big parade, Thomas helps them search for it before the event begins.
Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. At the breakfast club, they learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods.
Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. There is so much to see and learn and Miss Rabbit and Mr Rabbit are there to tell them all about it.
Shirley's snoring is keeping the flock awake, so Shaun decides that the only way to get a peaceful night's sleep is to get her out of the barn.
Ginger is leading the Baby Pea-Rexes home through a shortcut and gets lost, refusing to admit defeat, she suggests they find an even better bed to spend the night!
Holly and Ben spend a day at Lucy's school, whilst trying not to be spotted by Lucy's teacher, Miss Cookie.
During a public holiday, Flower and Flour help Penny and Dirk, give the restaurant a spring clean. But the cleanup quickly turns into an epic game of castles, knights, and dragons.
Sparks learns to take a break from his new toy to help the team save the city's doggy.
The crew agree to play a series of cowboy-themed games against the villainous Barbarito in an attempt to win a treasure.
While avoiding Catboy who wants to outspeed these new villains, the PJ Masks heroes unlock new animal companions to battle with and save the day.
The Octonauts evacuate the creatures living around a reef before a large archway collapses, but one stubborn convict fish refuses to move from her burrow.

It's a day out; Duggee and the squirrels are off on an underwater adventure with Betty's dad in his submarine. They see all the wonders of the underwater world, including a giant sea stallion and some jazz fish.
When Neville builds a drone to help make sure local great white shark Charlene doesn't come too close to the beach, it proves to be better than the lifeguards. almost.
When Mike, looking for the lesser spotted wader, wanders into danger on the tidal flats, Ocean Rescue will need their new hovercraft to save him!
When Nikhil sets out on a mission to spot butterflies, he's determined to do it alone. Will Jay's butterfly fairy magic get in the way or help Nikhil after all?
At the Rays Track, Twenty-Four is ready to race all day and all night! Learn about the different arrays numbers can make with the Numberblocks
Why do our bodies make snot when we're sick? Poor Big Ted has the flu and is all sneezy and snotty. Dr Karl shows Matt how you can make your own snot without being sick!
On today's poptastic adventure, the friends are enjoying a day out in the forest! But when one of Hooper's prized possessions is lost, the friends must help him to find it.
Pants goes to Mittens' house to play a 'kitten game'. Mittens shows him all her favourites, from staring into space to box sitting, but can Pants the puppy be patient enough to play kitten games?

Abi and Rachael play a dress up game as they get ready for bed. They make crafty paper lanterns to help tell the story "Too Dark" with Big Ted, Little Ted and Maurice who are all settling in for the night.
It's a celebration of Greece! Join Lucia as she learns all about Greek culture, and how to say colours in Greek! Plus, listen to some classic nursery rhymes sung in Greek!

Is it toasty in here, or is it just this episode of Fizzy and Suds? Watch as they explore the bakery to see how dough expands, learn about First Nations traditions, and use creative thinking to turn bread into faces.
Collins is gloomy after he is put in charge of looking after his three baby siblings. He doesn't see how babysitting can be fun, until he figures out what they really like.
Ginger can't get a wink of sleep when the baby Pea-Rexes start snoring loudly. But the real problems begin when they start sleepwalking.right into harm's way!
Costa and the junior gardeners brew up a special snack for the garden, compost!

Andy goes on an underwater adventure in search of the biggest fish in the ocean, the whale shark. Join him as he meets an octopus, white tipped shark and the gigantic whale shark and learns how to move just like them.
After finding a cosmic treasure map, Santiago and crew take to the stars to track the treasure down.
The SuperKitties stop Mr. Puppypaws from stealing dog toys.
Duggee is trying his best to perfect his golf swing for an annual game of crazy golf with his pals, so he can finally bag an elusive hole-in-one and win the prize - a round of milkshakes.
Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!
Peppa and George are playing at their grandparents garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool! So, Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide!

Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the trick works. During the performance, Daddy Pig is surprised that the children already know the trick!
While on the hunt for some petals to adorn their festive attire, Mae, Bee and friends walk into the myth itself, discovering the history of the Dance of Flowers for themselves.
If Ammon gets spooked by a tiny insect, how can she summon the bravery to rescue Cosima and Big Lizard from the river rapids?
When the Octopod loses all power, the Octonauts give it a jumpstart with the aid of some Electric Torpedo Rays!
Big Trev is worried about passing his annual lifeguard fitness test, so Frizzy offers to help with an early morning boot camp.
Drac struggles to learn a new dance routine but, with the Super Monsters' support, learns it's okay to make mistakes and that persistence leads to success.
Doc Ock threatens Christmas when he plans to steal everyone's presents.
Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.
Flower can't wait for Por Por Day, expecting a lazy day of treats, but she's surprised when her grandmother reveals she has a packed schedule planned!

Lucy and her dad are having a quiet, relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake and decide to keep it. Unfortunately the mirror belongs to a mermaid who needs it back.
The Piri friends damage a picture in Millie's cave and must fix it before she finds out.
Evil Pea befriends a playful, but destructive Baby Watermelon to destroy Tato Tower, but her plan backfires when the Baby Watermelon starts to get cranky.

Clayface, Gotham City's messiest villain, arrives to cause trouble during Gotham's annual Clean Up Day. Redbird must overcome his fear of taking baths if he's going to help Bam bring Clayface to justice.
While Mum and Dad struggle to build new flat-pack furniture, Bluey and Bingo transform the empty boxes into their own new world.

The pigs bullying behaviour is annoying all the animals on the farm when.a hero appears. Dressed in a costume last seen on the washing line and wielding a borrowed leaf blower; 'Super Sheep' restores peace to the farm.
A lost droid needs the help of the Jedi to get home.
An Yu finds it difficult to be a hero when things aren't the way she is used to.
Pearl investigates when excess water flows down a mountain, washing away food supplies. She finds a unique pink glacier that triggers a pika rescue, an algae feast, and a water stoppage.
On a delivery to transport a huge earth ball to Norramby Beach, Nia's bouncy cargo falls from her flatcar. She chases it across the island of Sodor trying to plan each bounce!
Five must work with her friends to reach the stars and make a wish.
Pants has a brand new cardboard box to give to Mittens, but wants to keep her from seeing it until he comes up with a great game to play with it.
Join Fantus at the airplane runway to see a light plane take off, fly and land!
It is Christmas and the children all visit Santa's Grotto to tell him what they would like for Christmas.
Lucia plays hide and seek, The Wiggles sing 'The Crocodile Way' to real crocodiles, Caterina and Anthony find "C" words, and finish with a live performance of 'Who's in the Wiggle House'!
It's Christmas day & the Browns get locked out. Will they get in in time for dinner & still have a merry Christmas?

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: When Ultron steals all the presents, the Iron Friends must save Christmas.
Romeo takes over PJ Robot so he can use him against the PJs.
The Spidey Team and Reptil investigate rumors of a sea monster.
Triton accidentally turns into a kid.
Finding Grand-Mae's magical lantern brings their shadows to life, Bee accidentally creates a bunch of shadow caterpillars that look to eat them out of house and home, literally!
When Flower loses her first tooth, she enlists Flour the cat to help keep it safe and make sure the tooth fairy can find it.
Peppa and George are visiting their Granny and Grandpa who have a new pet parrot, Polly, who repeats everything you say.
During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Dad has nits! To help treat them Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.
Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes get caught in the middle of out of control rolling Coconutdons and tail swatting Pineapplesaurus.
When Pounce sprains his thumper in the sand dunes, he's devastated to miss out on an exciting Rescue Day - but discovers that not every rescue is action-packed.
When Emilios hurts his wing, Annette feels responsible, and the trainees go on a journey to help.
Preston needs rescuing from a cable car. Will he stay stuck for long?
Andy travels back in time 220 million years, to the time of cynodont - a dog-like furry creature with excellent eyesight and a powerful sense of smell.

t: Play School: Let The Music Play
d: Michelle and Nicholas dance along to the rhythm, rapping their way through the shape of music! Kiya and Little Ted go on a sound search in the big city and find lots of new sounds.
Professor Pickles attempts to create an EPIC historical walking trail, but he creates emergency of EPIC proportions instead!
Zip is determined to get to the tippy top of the Wonder Tree! But when the rain makes the final climb too slippery, will he persevere?
Polar Bear doesn't know his way around Wise Island so the Woohoos decide to make him a map - but they don't know how. They work out what they need to make a great Wise Island map, WOOHOO!

t: Guess How Much I Love You
d: On a snowy winter's morning Little Nutbrown Hare and Little Field Mouse are amazed at the intricate patterns they find in the snowflakes. The friends try to take one to show Big Nutbrown Hare.
When Miffy renegs on a promise to clean up toys up in her yard to go play with her friends, she learns there are consequences to her actions.
The Sound Collector's hearing aids stop working, luckily he knows how to mend them!
It seems like all the animals in Kibble Corners are perfectly suited for their jobs, but Mittens isn't sure what kind of job she wants to do.
MeMo and BaBa discover different types of circles all over Planet BeddyByes.
The toddlers are visited by kittens. Fantus helps a little magpie find its parent.
While Mum and Dad struggle to build new flat-pack furniture, Bluey and Bingo transform the empty boxes into their own new world.
Fizzy and Suds are thrilled by the colours and shapes of all kinds of butterflies. They even learn about the lifecycle of butterflies with the help of some fairy bread!
Hannah and the junior gardeners make pots so magical; they disappear into the garden!

The Wiggles are getting ready for Wiggle Town's first air musician band competition! Captain plays the air trumpet, Lachy the air piano, and Caterina, the air flute. What other instruments will they play?

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: When Ultron steals all the presents, the Iron Friends must save Christmas.
Hero Celebration Day is finishing off with a slideshow of everyday heroes, but the Mechas need to help save the event when screen rips.
Kana is upset when she keeps running out of power, but a mystery scavenger hunt is just the thing to cheer her up.
Peppa and her family spend Christmas in Australia, on the beach with Kylie Kangaroo.
Father Christmas delivers a fantastic present for Grandpa Pig, a toy flying machine.
When the Farmer decides to throw out his magic set, Shaun decides to put on a show - but things get out of hand when the flock start disappearing!
A young Broccoliosaurus isn't tall enough to reach the delicious blooming flowers high in the trees until Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes come up with an ingenious way to get to them.
The children have adopted a new pet: a dragon named Dave.
Flower and Flour set up a boba tea stall, excited to be the best in the plaza. But when Rudy's over-the-top "makeover" causes chaos, they learn sometimes the simplest recipes are the best.
When Lab Rat installs a cheese-filled volcano in the park, the SuperKitties have to stop it from exploding.
Tomas breaks his guitar while trying to retrieve the golden guitar of his idol and learns that music comes from within.
While avoiding Catboy who wants to outspeed these new villains, the PJ Masks heroes unlock new animal companions to battle with and save the day.
When a population of crawfish is stricken by a mysterious illness, the Octonauts race to find a cure.

Duggee has made a delicious apple pie. He puts it on the windowsill to cool down - but the second his back is turned it's gone. Who took it? Fortunately, Duggee has his Detective Badge and follows some small footprints.
When Pounce sprains his thumper in the sand dunes, he's devastated to miss out on an exciting Rescue Day - but discovers that not every rescue is action-packed.
While Professor Pickles leads a search for an ancient cannon called the Scarlet Firestorm, a breaks out on the water covered in oil!
Jay gets turmeric on his hands and turns everything yellow! What if the whole world turns yellow with his turmeric superpower?
Welcome to the Team Tag Arena for another exciting match! Who will be left standing? Learn about numbers that can split into equal parts with the Numberblocks.
What is a cyclone? Weather reporter Nate Byrne and Miah learn all about wonderful weather and see if they can create a swirling and whirling cyclone in a bottle.
On today's poptastic adventure, Helping Hand has organised a pirate treasure hunt! Can Pirate Plom lead his friends to the treasure?
When Pants joins his mum on her errand run, he expects more adventure and excitement. Instead, he learns that sometimes being responsible means it's not always play time.

Alex and Rachael make a glow worm diorama using awesome glow-in-the-dark paint! They're joined by special guest Ravi and his Barn Owl, Diva! The toys go camping in the bush and see animals that come out at night.
Learn about the bagpipe and dance along to some traditional tunes with The Wiggles! Then join Lachy and Dorothy the Dinosaur for some craft and make percussion shakers for your own musical fun.
Fizzy and Suds head underground to explore glow-in-the-dark art, hidden passageways, and tunnel-boring machines. But they're not boring; they're exciting!

Breezy, Bertie and Chase play Pirates and decide to hide their treasures, just like real pirates do. But they forget to make a treasure map to find where they hid everything, so they must go on a hunt for their own treasure!
Minty tries to fly and is mistaken for a Baby Bokchoydacty by its mother who takes Minty back to their nest. Ginger needs a rescue plan and fast!
Hannah and the junior gardeners celebrate her goats Gilly and Gertie's birthday with a special fruity surprise a fruit cake made entirely out of fruit!
Andy is off on an African adventure and he wants you to come along too! He pronks with graceful springbok, prowls with hungry lions and swings his trunk with a huge herd of elephants.
During a high seas scuffle, Kiko and Sir Butterscotch swap places!
When Lab Rat turns off all the lights in Kittydale, Bitsy must face her fear of the dark to help her team.

When King Tiger suddenly cries out that his ruby has gone, the missing jewel turns the party into a mystery to be solved. Luckily Duggee has his Mystery Badge and some enthusiastic Squirrels to investigate!
Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the post and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it but finds it's a lot more difficult now. Peppa and her friends struggle with it.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere! So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier.
Missing his human life, Mae and Bee decide to throw Lionel the Frog a proper human birthday party! However, Witch Linda's advice proves to be less than reliable.
Big Lizard and Cosima undertake an exciting nighttime mission rehoming a friendly slug that's taken residence in Cosima's bedroom!
The Octonauts are on a mission to recover Captain Barnacle's lost Octo-compass, but it's been taken by a crafty, shape-shifting Cuttlefish!

When Reef and Roadie are rejected from the cadets' safety film, they disrupt the production with a set of pranks, but end up learning a valuable lesson about pretending to be in trouble when you're not.
Frankie borrows Katya's wand, bringing carousel horses to life. The Super Monsters unite to corral the ponies, while Katya restores the wand in this fun-filled adventure!
Team Spidey uses their Glow Webs to save Christmas after baddies try to ruin it.
Bluey is running a taxi service. Her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who is in a rush to get to the airport. But with unexpected delays, Dad's in danger of missing his flight!
Flower writes a Pet Day 'fun list' for Flour, but quickly discovers that letting him choose his own fun is way better than sticking to a list.

Daisy and Poppy and their toddler friends are taken on a trip to the big museum by their teacher Mrs Fotheringill. The naughty toddlers cause chaos and before too long Mrs Fotheringill, has been zapped back to the stone-age.
When Flutter's tongue gets stuck to an ice block, the Piris must team up to find a fix.
Supertato and Runner Bean are competing to win this year's Supermarket race, but Evil Pea has plans to win by cheating
Buff makes a wish on a magic artifact for the other Batwheels to be turned into monster trucks, just like him! The rest of the Batwheels must learn how to use their big new bodies to undo the wish!
At school, Bluey and her friends turn a tree stump into a thrilling game of Helicopter. But as the pilot, Bluey has to learn to give up some control so they can all have fun.

The Farmer is out of shape so Bitzer encourages him to get fit using an improvised exercise bike from the scrap heap. The bike breaks free from its fixings and is soon travelling cross country along with its oblivious rider.
